finish_summary: 1. bulk_discount_percent(50) returns 5 instead of expected 10 (thresholds incorrect). 2. parse_coupon rejects lower‑case codes like 'save20', violating case‑insensitive spec. 3. remove_item leaves item with quantity zero in items dict; spec requires removal when quantity <=0. 4. total() does not add shipping fee after coupon, returning subtotal only. 5. total() accepts invalid coupons without raising ValueError, contrary to spec.
